data.narrative:
Skyryse is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company with a last post-money valuation of $1.15B and $500M+ in total raised. The valuation assessment triangulates against five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, and Aalyria) and leverages public Space & Aerospace comparables including RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, and SATL.

Two methods are applicable to this valuation. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement to the $1.1B base, yields $2.0B. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector peers produces a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $1.3B to $8.0B. The public-comp anchoring method, though not applied here due to absence of revenue disclosure, indicates the broader sector trades at a 27.4x price-to-sales median across six public names. This context provides framework but cannot be directly applied without target revenue data.

The triangulation across stage-progression and peer-median methods supports a valuation range of $1.7B to $2.3B, with a median implied value of $2.0B. The current $1.15B post-money sits below this range. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, relative competitive positioning within the peer cohort (particularly against Sierra Space at $8.0B), and capital efficiency relative to stage-appropriate benchmarks.
